entities.summary: Pierre Statorius, Polish: Piotr Stoiński, Piotr Stojeński was a French grammarian and theologian, who settled among the Polish Brethren, becoming rector of a Calvinist Academy in Pińczów at the invitation of Francesco Lismanino.
